Of course! This is a great practical task for learning Qt. Reading Excel files in C++ requires a third-party library, as Qt doesn't have a built-in module for it. One of the most popular and easiest to integrate with Qt is **QXlsx**.

Here is a complete, step-by-step guide to building this application.

### Step 1: Project Setup and QXlsx Integration

Before writing any C++ code, you need to set up your Qt project to include the QXlsx library.

1.  **Create a New Qt Widgets Application:**
    *   Open Qt Creator.
    *   Go to `File -> New File or Project...`
    *   Select `Application (Qt) -> Qt Widgets Application`.
    *   Name your project (e.g., `ExcelConverter`).
    *   Choose a build system (qmake is fine).
    *   Select a kit (e.g., Desktop Qt 5.15.2 MSVC2019 64bit).

2.  **Download QXlsx:**
    *   Go to the QXlsx GitHub repository: [https://github.com/QtExcel/QXlsx](https://github.com/QtExcel/QXlsx)
    *   Click `Code -> Download ZIP`.
    *   Unzip the downloaded file. It will contain a folder named `QXlsx-master`.

3.  **Integrate QXlsx into Your Project:**
    *   Copy the `QXlsx-master/xlsx` subfolder into your project's main directory (the same place where your `.pro` file is).
    *   Rename the copied `xlsx` folder to simply `QXlsx` for clarity.
    *   Open your project's `.pro` file (e.g., `ExcelConverter.pro`) and add the following line at the end. This tells qmake to include the QXlsx library build rules.

    ```pro
    # Include the QXlsx library
    include(QXlsx/xlsx.pri)
    ```

Your `.pro` file should look something like this:

**ExcelConverter.pro**
```pro
QT       += core gui

greaterThan(QT_MAJOR_VERSION, 4): QT += widgets

CONFIG   += c++11

SOURCES += \
    main.cpp \
    mainwindow.cpp

HEADERS += \
    mainwindow.h

# Default rules for deployment.
qnx: target.path = /tmp/$${TARGET}/bin
else: unix:!android: target.path = /opt/$${TARGET}/bin
!isEmpty(target.path): INSTALLS += target

# Include the QXlsx library
include(QXlsx/xlsx.pri)
```

Now your project is ready. Let's write the code.

### Step 2: Designing the GUI

We'll create a simple layout programmatically. No need for the UI designer for this.

**mainwindow.h**
This file defines the main window class, its UI elements, and the functions (slots) that will handle user actions.

```cpp
#ifndef MAINWINDOW_H
#define MAINWINDOW_H

#include <QtWidgets>

class MainWindow : public QWidget
{
    Q_OBJECT

public:
    MainWindow(QWidget *parent = nullptr);
    ~MainWindow();

private slots:
    void onSelectDirectoryClicked();
    void onConvertClicked();

private:
    // Helper function for robust CSV generation
    QString escapeCsv(const QString &text);

    // UI Elements
    QPushButton *selectDirButton;
    QPushButton *convertButton;
    QLineEdit *directoryLineEdit;
    QTextEdit *logTextEdit;

    // Data
    QString selectedDirectory;
};
#endif // MAINWINDOW_H
```

### Step 3: Implementing the Logic

This is where the main work happens: setting up the UI, handling button clicks, and performing the file conversion.

**mainwindow.cpp**
```cpp
#include "mainwindow.h"

// Include the QXlsx header
#include "QXlsx/xlsxdocument.h"

MainWindow::MainWindow(QWidget *parent)
    : QWidget(parent)
{
    // --- UI Setup ---
    setWindowTitle("Excel to CSV Converter");
    setMinimumSize(500, 400);

    // Directory selection layout
    QHBoxLayout *dirLayout = new QHBoxLayout();
    directoryLineEdit = new QLineEdit();
    directoryLineEdit->setPlaceholderText("Select a directory containing Excel files...");
    directoryLineEdit->setReadOnly(true);
    selectDirButton = new QPushButton("Select Directory...");
    dirLayout->addWidget(directoryLineEdit);
    dirLayout->addWidget(selectDirButton);

    // Convert button
    convertButton = new QPushButton("Convert Files");
    convertButton->setEnabled(false); // Disabled until a directory is chosen

    // Log area
    logTextEdit = new QTextEdit();
    logTextEdit->setReadOnly(true);
    logTextEdit->append("Welcome! Please select a directory to begin.");

    // Main layout
    QVBoxLayout *mainLayout = new QVBoxLayout();
    mainLayout->addLayout(dirLayout);
    mainLayout->addWidget(convertButton);
    mainLayout->addWidget(logTextEdit);
    setLayout(mainLayout);

    // --- Connections ---
    connect(selectDirButton, &QPushButton::clicked, this, &MainWindow::onSelectDirectoryClicked);
    connect(convertButton, &QPushButton::clicked, this, &MainWindow::onConvertClicked);
}

MainWindow::~MainWindow()
{
}

void MainWindow::onSelectDirectoryClicked()
{
    QString dir = QFileDialog::getExistingDirectory(this, "Select Directory", QDir::homePath());

    if (!dir.isEmpty()) {
        selectedDirectory = dir;
        directoryLineEdit->setText(selectedDirectory);
        logTextEdit->append(QString("Selected directory: %1").arg(selectedDirectory));
        convertButton->setEnabled(true);
    }
}

void MainWindow::onConvertClicked()
{
    if (selectedDirectory.isEmpty()) {
        QMessageBox::warning(this, "Warning", "Please select a directory first.");
        return;
    }

    // Disable buttons during conversion to prevent re-clicks
    convertButton->setEnabled(false);
    selectDirButton->setEnabled(false);
    logTextEdit->clear();
    logTextEdit->append("Starting conversion process...");

    QDir sourceDir(selectedDirectory);
    QString outputFolderName = "csv_exports";
    QString outputDirPath = sourceDir.filePath(outputFolderName);

    // Create the output directory
    if (!QDir(outputDirPath).exists()) {
        if (sourceDir.mkdir(outputFolderName)) {
            logTextEdit->append(QString("Created output folder: %1").arg(outputDirPath));
        } else {
            logTextEdit->append(QString("Error: Could not create output folder."));
            QMessageBox::critical(this, "Error", "Failed to create the 'csv_exports' sub-directory. Check permissions.");
            convertButton->setEnabled(true);
            selectDirButton->setEnabled(true);
            return;
        }
    } else {
        logTextEdit->append(QString("Output folder already exists: %1").arg(outputDirPath));
    }

    // Find all Excel files
    QStringList excelFilters;
    excelFilters << "*.xlsx" << "*.xls";
    sourceDir.setNameFilters(excelFilters);
    QStringList excelFiles = sourceDir.entryList(QDir::Files);

    if (excelFiles.isEmpty()) {
        logTextEdit->append("No Excel files (.xlsx, .xls) found in the selected directory.");
    }

    int filesConverted = 0;
    // Process each Excel file
    for (const QString &excelFileName : excelFiles) {
        QString inputFilePath = sourceDir.filePath(excelFileName);
        logTextEdit->append(QString("\nProcessing: %1").arg(excelFileName));
        QCoreApplication::processEvents(); // Keep GUI responsive

        // Load the excel file using QXlsx
        QXlsx::Document xlsx(inputFilePath);

        if (!xlsx.load()) {
            logTextEdit->append("  -> Error: Could not load this file. It might be corrupt or an unsupported format.");
            continue;
        }

        // An Excel file can have multiple sheets. We'll convert each one.
        for (const QString &sheetName : xlsx.sheetNames()) {
            QXlsx::Worksheet *sheet = static_cast<QXlsx::Worksheet*>(xlsx.sheet(sheetName));
            if (!sheet) continue;

            QString baseName = QFileInfo(excelFileName).baseName();
            QString safeSheetName = sheetName;
            safeSheetName.replace(QRegularExpression("[^a-zA-Z0-9_]"), "_"); // Make sheet name file-system safe
            
            QString outputCsvFileName = QString("%1_%2.csv").arg(baseName, safeSheetName);
            QString outputCsvFilePath = QDir(outputDirPath).filePath(outputCsvFileName);
            
            QFile outputFile(outputCsvFilePath);
            if (outputFile.open(QIODevice::WriteOnly | QIODevice::Text)) {
                QTextStream out(&outputFile);

                int maxRow = sheet->dimension().lastRow();
                int maxCol = sheet->dimension().lastColumn();

                for (int row = 1; row <= maxRow; ++row) {
                    QStringList rowData;
                    for (int col = 1; col <= maxCol; ++col) {
                        QXlsx::Cell *cell = sheet->cellAt(row, col);
                        if (cell) {
                            rowData << escapeCsv(cell->value().toString());
                        } else {
                            rowData << ""; // Empty cell
                        }
                    }
                    out << rowData.join(',') << "\n";
                }
                outputFile.close();
                logTextEdit->append(QString("  -> Converted sheet '%1' to %2").arg(sheetName, outputCsvFileName));
                filesConverted++;
            } else {
                logTextEdit->append(QString("  -> Error: Could not write to file %1").arg(outputCsvFileName));
            }
        }
    }

Of course! This is a great practical task for learning Qt. Reading Excel files in C++ requires a third-party library, as Qt doesn't have a built-in module for it. One of the most popular and easiest to integrate with Qt is **QXlsx**.

Here is a complete, step-by-step guide to building this application.

### Step 1: Project Setup and QXlsx Integration

Before writing any C++ code, you need to set up your Qt project to include the QXlsx library.

1.  **Create a New Qt Widgets Application:**
    *   Open Qt Creator.
    *   Go to `File -> New File or Project...`
    *   Select `Application (Qt) -> Qt Widgets Application`.
    *   Name your project (e.g., `ExcelConverter`).
    *   Choose a build system (qmake is fine).
    *   Select a kit (e.g., Desktop Qt 5.15.2 MSVC2019 64bit).

2.  **Download QXlsx:**
    *   Go to the QXlsx GitHub repository: [https://github.com/QtExcel/QXlsx](https://github.com/QtExcel/QXlsx)
    *   Click `Code -> Download ZIP`.
    *   Unzip the downloaded file. It will contain a folder named `QXlsx-master`.

3.  **Integrate QXlsx into Your Project:**
    *   Copy the `QXlsx-master/xlsx` subfolder into your project's main directory (the same place where your `.pro` file is).
    *   Rename the copied `xlsx` folder to simply `QXlsx` for clarity.
    *   Open your project's `.pro` file (e.g., `ExcelConverter.pro`) and add the following line at the end. This tells qmake to include the QXlsx library build rules.

    ```pro
    # Include the QXlsx library
    include(QXlsx/xlsx.pri)
    ```

Your `.pro` file should look something like this:

**ExcelConverter.pro**
```pro
QT       += core gui

greaterThan(QT_MAJOR_VERSION, 4): QT += widgets

CONFIG   += c++11

SOURCES += \
    main.cpp \
    mainwindow.cpp

HEADERS += \
    mainwindow.h

# Default rules for deployment.
qnx: target.path = /tmp/$${TARGET}/bin
else: unix:!android: target.path = /opt/$${TARGET}/bin
!isEmpty(target.path): INSTALLS += target

# Include the QXlsx library
include(QXlsx/xlsx.pri)
```

Now your project is ready. Let's write the code.

### Step 2: Designing the GUI

We'll create a simple layout programmatically. No need for the UI designer for this.

**mainwindow.h**
This file defines the main window class, its UI elements, and the functions (slots) that will handle user actions.

```cpp

#define MAINWINDOW_H

    Q_OBJECT

    ~MainWindow();

private slots:

    void onConvertClicked();

private:

    QString escapeCsv(const QString &text);

### Step 3: Implementing the Logic

This is where the main work happens: setting up the UI, handling button clicks, and performing the file conversion.

**mainwindow.cpp**
```cpp
#include "mainwindow.h"

// Include the QXlsx header
#include "QXlsx/xlsxdocument.h"

MainWindow::MainWindow(QWidget *parent)
    : QWidget(parent)
{
    // --- UI Setup ---
    setWindowTitle("Excel to CSV Converter");
    setMinimumSize(500, 400);

    // Directory selection layout
    QHBoxLayout *dirLayout = new QHBoxLayout();
    directoryLineEdit = new QLineEdit();
    directoryLineEdit->setPlaceholderText("Select a directory containing Excel files...");
    directoryLineEdit->setReadOnly(true);
    selectDirButton = new QPushButton("Select Directory...");
    dirLayout->addWidget(directoryLineEdit);
    dirLayout->addWidget(selectDirButton);

    // Convert button
    convertButton = new QPushButton("Convert Files");
    convertButton->setEnabled(false); // Disabled until a directory is chosen

    // Log area
    logTextEdit = new QTextEdit();
    logTextEdit->setReadOnly(true);
    logTextEdit->append("Welcome! Please select a directory to begin.");

    // Main layout
    QVBoxLayout *mainLayout = new QVBoxLayout();
    mainLayout->addLayout(dirLayout);
    mainLayout->addWidget(convertButton);
    mainLayout->addWidget(logTextEdit);
    setLayout(mainLayout);

    // --- Connections ---
    connect(selectDirButton, &QPushButton::clicked, this, &MainWindow::onSelectDirectoryClicked);
    connect(convertButton, &QPushButton::clicked, this, &MainWindow::onConvertClicked);
}

MainWindow::~MainWindow()
{
}

void MainWindow::onSelectDirectoryClicked()
{
    QString dir = QFileDialog::getExistingDirectory(this, "Select Directory", QDir::homePath());

    if (!dir.isEmpty()) {
        selectedDirectory = dir;
        directoryLineEdit->setText(selectedDirectory);
        logTextEdit->append(QString("Selected directory: %1").arg(selectedDirectory));
        convertButton->setEnabled(true);
    }
}

void MainWindow::onConvertClicked()
{
    if (selectedDirectory.isEmpty()) {
        QMessageBox::warning(this, "Warning", "Please select a directory first.");
        return;
    }

    // Disable buttons during conversion to prevent re-clicks
    convertButton->setEnabled(false);
    selectDirButton->setEnabled(false);
    logTextEdit->clear();
    logTextEdit->append("Starting conversion process...");

    QDir sourceDir(selectedDirectory);
    QString outputFolderName = "csv_exports";
    QString outputDirPath = sourceDir.filePath(outputFolderName);

    // Create the output directory
    if (!QDir(outputDirPath).exists()) {
        if (sourceDir.mkdir(outputFolderName)) {
            logTextEdit->append(QString("Created output folder: %1").arg(outputDirPath));
        } else {
            logTextEdit->append(QString("Error: Could not create output folder."));
            QMessageBox::critical(this, "Error", "Failed to create the 'csv_exports' sub-directory. Check permissions.");
            convertButton->setEnabled(true);
            selectDirButton->setEnabled(true);
            return;
        }
    } else {
        logTextEdit->append(QString("Output folder already exists: %1").arg(outputDirPath));
    }

    // Find all Excel files
    QStringList excelFilters;
    excelFilters << "*.xlsx" << "*.xls";
    sourceDir.setNameFilters(excelFilters);
    QStringList excelFiles = sourceDir.entryList(QDir::Files);

    if (excelFiles.isEmpty()) {
        logTextEdit->append("No Excel files (.xlsx, .xls) found in the selected directory.");
    }

    int filesConverted = 0;
    // Process each Excel file
    for (const QString &excelFileName : excelFiles) {
        QString inputFilePath = sourceDir.filePath(excelFileName);
        logTextEdit->append(QString("\nProcessing: %1").arg(excelFileName));
        QCoreApplication::processEvents(); // Keep GUI responsive

        // Load the excel file using QXlsx
        QXlsx::Document xlsx(inputFilePath);

        if (!xlsx.load()) {
            logTextEdit->append("  -> Error: Could not load this file. It might be corrupt or an unsupported format.");
            continue;
        }

        // An Excel file can have multiple sheets. We'll convert each one.
        for (const QString &sheetName : xlsx.sheetNames()) {
            QXlsx::Worksheet *sheet = static_cast<QXlsx::Worksheet*>(xlsx.sheet(sheetName));
            if (!sheet) continue;

            QString baseName = QFileInfo(excelFileName).baseName();
            QString safeSheetName = sheetName;
            safeSheetName.replace(QRegularExpression("[^a-zA-Z0-9_]"), "_"); // Make sheet name file-system safe
            
            QString outputCsvFileName = QString("%1_%2.csv").arg(baseName, safeSheetName);
            QString outputCsvFilePath = QDir(outputDirPath).filePath(outputCsvFileName);
            
            QFile outputFile(outputCsvFilePath);
            if (outputFile.open(QIODevice::WriteOnly | QIODevice::Text)) {
                QTextStream out(&outputFile);

                int maxRow = sheet->dimension().lastRow();
                int maxCol = sheet->dimension().lastColumn();

                for (int row = 1; row <= maxRow; ++row) {
                    QStringList rowData;
                    for (int col = 1; col <= maxCol; ++col) {
                        QXlsx::Cell *cell = sheet->cellAt(row, col);
                        if (cell) {
                            rowData << escapeCsv(cell->value().toString());
                        } else {
                            rowData << ""; // Empty cell
                        }
                    }
                    out << rowData.join(',') << "\n";
                }
                outputFile.close();
                logTextEdit->append(QString("  -> Converted sheet '%1' to %2").arg(sheetName, outputCsvFileName));
                filesConverted++;
            } else {
                logTextEdit->append(QString("  -> Error: Could not write to file %1").arg(outputCsvFileName));
            }
        }
    }
